document_notes: The page image shows page number 314, although the prompt metadata refers to page 330.

The entry for L. Aurelius Gallus (cos. 198) is continued from the preceding page; the lemma header itself is on the previous page, but the text on this page contains the crucial governorship attestation for Moesia inferior.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as 'Legatus Aug. pro pr. consularis (provinciae Moesiae inferioris)' under Septimius Severus and Caracalla.

segments.name_variants: L. Aur[elius Gal]lus, Αὐρή(λιος) Γάλλος, Αὐρ. Γάλλος, Αὐρ. Γάλλου, ὑπ. Αὐρ. Γάλλου
segments.identification_and_sources: Coins of Nicopolis ad Istrum (Νικοπολειτῶν πρὸς Ἴστρον) mentioning ὑπ. Αὐρ. Γάλλου / ὑπ. Αὐρ. Γάλλ. / ὑπ. Αὐ. Γάλλου. Inscriptions: XIV 4562, 2 (fasti), IGR 3, 848 (Cilicia, corrected), VI 36936, VI 31133.
segments.offices_and_career: Consul ordinarius in a. 198 with P. Martius Saturninus (XIV 4562, 2). Perhaps curator aedium sacrarum vel operum publicorum (VI 31133).
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Aug. pro pr. consularis (provinciae Moesiae inferioris) Severo et Antonino regnantibus f. 1—4, nummi, intra a. 202—205 cusi, id quod inde colligitur, quod in nummis comparet Fulvia Plautilla.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Filius videtur L. Aurelii Galli consulis a. 174. Parentela cum his Aureliis Gallis coniunctus fuisse videtur L. Iunius L. f. Gal(eria) Aurelius Neratius Gallus Fulvius Macer VI 1433.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Discussion of the coins of Nicopolis ad Istrum and the reading of the governor's name (ὑπ. Αὐρ. Γάλλου). Discussion of the fasti and the correction of IGR 3, 848.
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: Ruzicka Num. Z. p. 141sq., Grose l. l. 2, 173 n. 4398, Macdonald Hunter. Coll. 1 p. 414, 9, Cesano Annuario di Atene 3, 174, Ant. Münz. n. 1654-1659, 1536, 1632, Pick, M. Britschkoff Ath. Mitt. l. l. p. 118.
